title: THE HUD PANEL TOGGLE IS A CHEVRON
why: His orders of 2026-10-12 (#35 redo the HUD, #50 make it look like a AAA game). The CONDITIONS, CURRENT PILLAGERS and controls panels in a raid ended their title with [-] or [+] in grey text, which read as developer UI. They draw a small chevron in the same spot now, up while open and down while folded. The click that folds them is the same.
now: The raid HUD panels fold with a small chevron instead of [-].

edits.replacement: hudChev(bx+bw-pad,ry,!HOc.c);   // vNN.xx (ui5q2p): a drawn chevron, not [-]
hudChev(PADX-8+LW-LH(6),y0-LH(2),!HOr.c);   // vNN.xx (ui5q2p): a drawn chevron, not [-]
hudChev(mx-8+MW-4,my+LH(4),true);   // vNN.xx (ui5q2p): a drawn chevron, not [-]
